bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; sales and use; providing a refundable exemption for construction materials used in certain projects in the city of Albert Lea.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+CITY OF ALBERT LEA; SALES TAX EXEMPTION FOR CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Exemption; refund.+]

[+(a) Materials and supplies used or consumed in and equipment incorporated into the construction, reconstruction, upgrade, expansion, renovation, or remodeling of ice rinks in the city of Albert Lea are exempt from sales and use tax under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 297A, provided that the materials, supplies, and equipment are purchased after April 9, 2024, and before January 1, 2027. +]

[+(b) The tax must be imposed and collected as if the rate under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.62, subdivisions 1 and 1a, applied and then refunded in the same manner provided for projects under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.75, subdivision 1, clause (17). Refunds for eligible purchases must not be issued until after June 30, 2024. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+The amount required to pay the refunds under subdivision 1 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective retroactively for sales and purchases made after April 9, 2024, and before January 1, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; sales and use; providing a refundable exemption for construction materials used in certain projects in the city of Albert Lea.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. CITY OF ALBERT LEA; SALES TAX EXEMPTION FOR CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS.

Subdivision 1.

Exemption; refund.

(a) Materials and supplies used or consumed in and equipment incorporated into the construction, reconstruction, upgrade, expansion, renovation, or remodeling of ice rinks in the city of Albert Lea are exempt from sales and use tax under Minnesota Statutes, chapter 297A, provided that the materials, supplies, and equipment are purchased after April 9, 2024, and before January 1, 2027.

(b) The tax must be imposed and collected as if the rate under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.62, subdivisions 1 and 1a, applied and then refunded in the same manner provided for projects under Minnesota Statutes, section 297A.75, subdivision 1, clause (17). Refunds for eligible purchases must not be issued until after June 30, 2024.

Subd. 2.

Appropriation.

The amount required to pay the refunds under subdivision 1 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective retroactively for sales and purchases made after April 9, 2024, and before January 1, 2027.
